invariant: Two non-antipodal corners suffice to uniquely determine a proper cube rotation if their correspondences and common coordinate frame are known. Two antipodal corners do not; a corner plus one consistently tracked RGB axis also suffices.
critical_distinction: Geometric distinguishability is not evidence-source independence. Three copied observations with one source root remain one lineage.
scope: Discrete cube symmetry, symbolic RGB labels across visible/UV/IR copies; no measured particle physics.
